exposure: Women at risk of VTE during the postpartum period
Women at risk of VTE during pregnancy
cohort: 220 pregnant women with an underlying medical condition in South Africa
finding: Doctors in South Africa are generally aware of VTE risk during pregnancy and the postpartum period, but adherence to VTE guidelines, specifically in terms of duration of thromboprophylaxis and its utilization during pregnancy, was suboptimal.
mod_finding: The study found that patients who received thromboprophylaxis for only 5-10 days after cesarean delivery was suboptimal adherence to VTE guidelines.
